name: gnomAD structural variants and copy-number variants

version.value: SVs v4.1.0, CNVs v4.1.0 (site header); also SVs v2.1

scope: Genome SV callset (VCF 1.74 GB sites file) and exome CNV callset (8.9 MB VCF; non-neuro and non-neuro-controls subsets).

quantitative.summary: Allele counts/frequencies per ancestry, SV type and size.

coverage_limitations: Short-read SV sensitivity is limited for repeats and complex events
CNV callset is exome-based so non-coding CNVs are missed
known_omissions: Long-read SV catalogue (release/lr) was listed but not inspected

reuse_decision.rationale: CNV VCF is small and fetched now; the 1.74 GB SV sites VCF is deferred until SV analysis begins.
